Priyanka: Keanu Reeves being wholesome at the piano. pure serotonin.
Omar: the distracted boyfriend meme but replaced with 'new tech' vs 'my todo list' :rofl:

Leah: here's a classic: https://giphy.com/gifs/this-is-fine-K2czs8ZQY7k5a   (dog in burning room)

Priyanka: https://giphy.com/gifs/keanu-reeves-piano-1g3A0ZQy1aPZC  (instant calm)
giphybot: :robot_face: 2 GIFs posted in thread.
Omar: posting my contribution: https://imgur.com/a/distracted-dev (replace person with 'new shiny library')

Noah: voting to have a meme-share channel. low-effort morale boost.
Leah: agreed. also, if anyone has wholesome animals, drop them here. instant mood elevator. :dog:
